def load():

    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import os

d = os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
sessions_file = d + '/../sessions/' + os.path.basename(d) + '.jsonl'
sessions_data = open(sessions_file).read().replace('\\n', '\n')

def parse_demo(text):
    demos = {}
    pattern = r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n'
    for m in re.finditer(pattern, text):
        k, cols = m[1], (int(m[2]), int(m[3]))
        rows = [r.split() for r in text[m.end():].split('\n')[:cols[0]]]
        if k not in demos and all(len(r) == cols[1] and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            demos[k] = [[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return demos

G = parse_demo(sessions_data)
print('Keys found:', sorted(G.keys()))
for k in sorted(G.keys()):
    print(f'\n{k}: {G[k][0]}')
